observations: The page number «2» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

L06 and L20: the chapter headings, «Cap. 1. Descriptio anni arabum.» and «Cap. 2. Descriptio anni romanorum.», in a bold roman type, centred; in the left margin beside them the folios of M and N at which the chapters begin, «M 83r» and «N 8v». L02: «Ptolomaei» is letter-spaced, «elmagesti» in italics; the Arabic words of the text (elkebice, elmuharram, zafar, dulheia) are in italics.

N02: the D of «De» is printed broken, only its stem and the right part of its bowl visible; transcribed «De». N04: «XXlIII», the third numeral a lower-case l, taller than the I's and with a slanting head serif; transcribed as printed (see the critical note). N05: the s of «suprascr.» is upright, the rest of the word italic; N10: the c of «cum» is italic, the rest of the word upright; transcribed as printed. N08: «partes. erunt», a full stop where the sentence goes on; transcribed as printed. N10: «CCCL[I]V», the square brackets the editor's, supplying the I that O lacks.
N01: «(S.)», the editor's initial, marks a reading of his own. The semicolons of the text and the apparatus stand after the thin space of the edition (8-11 px measured).
Marks not transcribed: a light mark above the o of «vero» (L11) and a light speck above the last e of «positione» (N13).

critical_notes.evidence: the sentence «Si enim dies in XXX dividatur partes, erunt earum XI totius diei quinta et sexta» runs on: the condition and its consequence are divided by a full stop where a comma is needed
critical_notes.impact: none on the reading of O that the note reports

critical_notes.evidence: the numeral, twenty-four hours, is set with a lower-case l in the place of the first I
